svg.text: Next.js Web + Flutter Mobile + FastAPI + MongoDB/Redis/Celery + AI + Observability
Primary data: users · products · orders · payments · warehouse · chat
Core flow: Clients → Nginx → FastAPI → Services → MongoDB/Redis + Celery → AI & External Services
JWT auth (NextAuth ↔ FastAPI) · Role-based access (admin/customer/farmer/delivery/warehouse) · OTP via email/SMS/Vonage
